input.reason: src/git-auth.ts:8 gates the Authorization header on remoteUrl.includes("github.com"), a substring test that a lookalike host such as github.com.evil.example satisfies. src/worktree.ts:15 spreads gitAuthArgs(repo.remoteUrl, SERVICE_TOKEN) into `git clone repo.remoteUrl`, so git sends `Authorization: Bearer <HARBOR_GITHUB_TOKEN>` (src/config.ts:4) to that host. src/routes.ts:18-22 registerRepo takes remoteUrl directly from req.body, checks only presence, has no admin check or host validation, and calls cloneRepo; src/store.ts:16-18 insertRepo adds no validation. No URL parsing or tests exist in the repository. Every claim in F08 is supported.
input.summary: gitAuthArgs substring host check leaks service token to lookalike hosts

findings.text: The host check is a substring match, so a remote URL such as `https://github.com.evil.example/x.git` passes and receives the service token in an `Authorization` header. Any user who can register a repository can collect the token.
findings.reason: Substring match: src/git-auth.ts:8 `if (remoteUrl.includes("github.com"))`. The example URL passes: it contains the substring `github.com`, and no `new URL`/hostname parsing exists anywhere in src/. Token in an Authorization header: src/git-auth.ts:9 returns `http.extraHeader=Authorization: Bearer ${token}`, and src/worktree.ts:15 passes SERVICE_TOKEN (src/config.ts:4, process.env.HARBOR_GITHUB_TOKEN) and runs `git clone repo.remoteUrl` with those args, so git sends the header to the attacker's host. Any registering user can collect it: src/routes.ts:18-22 registerRepo reads remoteUrl from req.body, checks only `!id || !remoteUrl`, has no admin gate or host allowlist, and calls cloneRepo with the user-supplied URL; src/store.ts:16-18 insertRepo adds no validation.

input.severity_reason: Exploitable credential leak: any authenticated user can call registerRepo (src/routes.ts:18-22) with a remoteUrl on a host they control whose name contains "github.com", and the service's GitHub token is sent to that host as a Bearer Authorization header (src/git-auth.ts:8-9, src/worktree.ts:15). No validation, admin gating, or tests prevent it.
